name: Combat Mastery
body:
School divination; Level magus 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one willing creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The touched target gains a combat feat of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites. This spell does not stack with other castings of the spell, but subsequent castings can extend the duration and change the feat.
